subject.title: feishu plugin does not implement capabilities.inlineButtons; ask_user choice card silently downgrades to plain text on feishu DM

question: Should Feishu become a supported native `ask_user` callback transport, or should it retain the documented numbered-text fallback?
rationale: Current public docs do not promise native Feishu question callbacks, while current Feishu code has related interactive-card primitives; choosing the permanent channel contract requires owner intent.

options.title: Support native Feishu choices
options.body: Define Feishu as a supported `ask_user` transport and implement the outbound choice-card plus inbound callback bridge with real DM proof.

options.title: Keep text fallback
options.body: Keep Feishu on the numbered text-question fallback and ensure no prompt, schema, or documentation suggests that a no-op inline-buttons setting enables it.

recommendation.title: Support native Feishu choices
recommendation.body: Define Feishu as a supported `ask_user` transport and implement the outbound choice-card plus inbound callback bridge with real DM proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu message-tool and card-interaction history makes this the strongest available routing candidate.
